channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: ‘Better deal’: What’s behind Trump’s rejection of Iran’s truce offer?
item.description: Experts say Trump sees economic sanctions as key to extracting more concessions but he risks losing leverage.

item.title: Yemen government forces widen attacks against Houthis: What we know
item.description: Yemeni government forces claim multiple air and ground operations across Taiz in 24 hours.

item.title: Iran shifts trade north to Caspian Sea as war impairs Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran is looking for alternatives to export its oil as the US blockades its southern ports.

item.title: At least 27 people killed in two shootings in South African townships
item.description: Incidents in Wedela southwest of ​Johannesburg and Lwandle near Cape Town come days after Durban mass shooting.

item.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
item.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.

item.title: Killer Christa Pike is to be executed within days but her defence say she's a victim too
item.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

item.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
item.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

item.title: Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game
item.description: Republic of Ireland players intend to wear black armbands "in recognition of all lives lost in the [Gaza] conflict" for match against Israel.

item.title: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
item.description: The independent report also says Kirk's aides insisted he speak outdoors, overriding concerns from campus officials.
